extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is an inline cement rock catcher with SS screen used for?
faqs.a: An inline cement rock catcher is installed in bulk cement transfer lines to stop debris, rocks and aggregated cement chunks from entering silos or the mixing system. It has a stainless-steel screen with a project-selected mesh size and a dump line for scheduled debris evacuation.

faqs.q: What mesh size does the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen use?
faqs.a: The stainless-steel screen is supplied with a mesh size selected for the project. State the cement grade and the largest particle or lump size you must pass on the RFQ, and the mesh is chosen to match.

faqs.q: What size is the vessel of the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen?
faqs.a: The vessel volume is engineered to the client throughput and the bulk-line size, so there is no single standard size. Send the line size and the transfer rate and the vessel is sized from them.

faqs.q: How do I know when the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen needs emptying?
faqs.a: An optional pressure differential indicator and high-debris alarm show when the screen is loading up. Without them, empty the vessel through the dump line on a scheduled basis, as the listing describes.

faqs.q: What is the screen of the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen made from?
faqs.a: The screen is stainless steel. Choose stainless for the abrasion and corrosion resistance needed in cement transfer; the vessel material and coating are set to project requirements.

faqs.q: What options does the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen offer?
faqs.a: The listing offers a pressure differential indicator and a high-debris alarm, and a dump line for scheduled evacuation of debris. State the instrumentation you need on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What does the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen connect to?
faqs.a: It sits in the bulk cement transfer line ahead of the silos and the mixing system. See [cement silos](/c/cementing-silos) and [batch mixers](/c/cementing-batch-mixer) for the equipment it protects.

faqs.q: How does the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen differ from a dust collector?
faqs.a: A rock catcher is an inline screen that protects equipment from debris and lumps, while a [dust collector](/p/cement-dust-collector-velocity-drop-50-cu-ft-vessel-synthetic-fabric-bag) cleans the vent air. They do different jobs and often run together.

faqs.q: Where is the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen used?
faqs.a: It is used in bulk cement transfer lines on oilfield cementing spreads to prevent blockages and damage to silos and mixers. See the guide on [cementing and drilling-fluid equipment](/blog/cementing-and-drilling-fluid-equipment).

faqs.q: How is a cement rock catcher emptied?
faqs.a: Debris is evacuated through the dump line on a schedule, or when the differential pressure indicator or high-debris alarm shows the screen is loading. Close and depressurise the line before opening the vessel.

faqs.q: What should I send for a cement rock catcher quotation?
faqs.a: Send the bulk-line size, the throughput, the working pressure of the transfer line, the mesh size, the instrumentation options and the mounting. The vessel is engineered to your throughput.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the inline cement rock catcher with SS screen as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send your capacity, drive and mounting requirements through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
